models.note: CrisperWhisper 2.0 large: verbatim transcription (fillers, repetitions, false starts, vocal events) or intended text, with word times from trained alignment heads. Evaluated on 10 languages (human-labelled sets for English and German, synthetic verbatim sets for the others). Needs the crisperwhisper package.

Small Whisper for quick runs and tests.
pyannote.audio 4.x. Gated: accept the conditions on Hugging Face and provide a token (HF_TOKEN). Gives full (overlapping) and exclusive diarization.

models.licence_note: model weights CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Wang et al., Wespeaker, ICASSP 2023); trained on VoxCeleb2, whose site describes it as for research purposes, with the audio's copyright held by the original YouTube uploaders. Check that this fits your use.
models.note: WeSpeaker ResNet34-LM speaker embeddings (26.5 MB ONNX, not gated) + flexasr's clustering. Trained on VoxCeleb2; see the licence note. Needs onnxruntime; no account.

WhisperX forced alignment with its default wav2vec2 model per language (models downloaded by whisperx; licences differ per language). Fallback aligner; better ones (Qwen3-ForcedAligner, NeMo FA) planned.
